    Restriction along a surjective algebra map #

    For a surjective φ : A →ₐ[k] A', every A'-module is an A-module (resFD φ X). Restriction is fully faithful (resHomEquiv), and it preserves and reflects indecomposability (isIndecMod_res_iff). This identifies modules over a quotient algebra, for instance over a convex subpiece, with the A-modules they give.
